Situated in the Upper Fraser Valley amongst the mountains, lakes and rivers of Chilliwack BC. Reclaimed Massage Therapy, Health and Wellness is a collaborative effort between two Registered Massage Therapists. Their vision is to build a therapist and patient focused wellness center using a multidisciplinary approach to provide whole body healthcare. This clinic is a collaborative effort as healthcare evolves into team-based and preventative approach to treatment.

Michelle Brown, RMT/Clinic Manager and Nick Nicola, RMT/Clinic Manager, bring a wealth of knowledge, experience, passion and compassion to both their individual treatments and the clinic itself.

Visit us at https://www.reclaimedhealthgroup.com/ 
Read our reviews: https://www.google.com/maps?cid=1152872976613417251
Review us: https://search.google.com/local/writereview?placeid=ChIJR3CgqLxAhFQRI6EwMt3T_w8
